positions.name: QuillmoorParticipantDataRetention
positions.frame: how long should participant field recordings and their transcripts be kept, given how far participant consent can be counted on to reach?
positions.why: All three segments read in one direction: the retention terms for Quillmoor participant data. src-1 changes the recording retention period, src-2 gives the consent-renewal evidence (low response to the September letters) behind that change, and src-3 says transcripts are not affected. The set holds a quiet difference in treatment: recordings are time-limited because consent decays, while transcripts stay permanent. The frame leaves that difference open for the members to answer.
